call_points.text: FY27 grey cement volume guidance maintained at 23 million tons plus, despite seasonal uncertainties.
Fuel cost per Kcal expected to rise from 1.71 in Q2 to over ₹2 in H2FY27.
Brownfield expansions at Muddapur and Panna to add 5-6 MTPA each post-FY28.
Net debt expected to peak at approximately ₹6,000 Cr upon reaching 50 MTPA capacity.
Cement prices increased by approximately ₹20 per bag from mid-September to mid-October.
Construction activity expected to slow down in November due to labor migration during festivals.
Mahan coal block expected to be operational in H1FY29 with coal cost of ₹1-1.25.
Standalone EBITDA per tonne fell 6% YoY to ₹852/t in Q2FY27 from ₹902/t due to seasonal cost absorption.
Management expects double-digit volume growth in FY27, driven by incremental volumes of at least 2.5 million tons.
Industry demand is expected to grow at 6% to 8% in FY27.
Company expects about ₹50 per ton cost savings in FY27, driven mainly by green power and AFR.
Gross debt as of March 31, 2026 stood at ₹5,136 crores with net cash of ₹1,765 crores and net debt of ₹3,370 crores.
Grey cement volume growth was driven by extended footprint in the Central Region and East Market.
Pet coke prices increased significantly due to the geopolitical situation arising out of the US-Iran War.

operating_notes.text: Declared preferred bidder for Karunda Limestone Block-I in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan over 35.98 hectares.
Declared preferred bidder for Maliyakheri Limestone Block-I in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan over 6.90 hectares.
Invested ₹4.22 Cr for a 26% equity stake in Truere Guj SPV Private Limited for captive solar power generation.
Received GST demand order of ₹0.08 Cr from Ahmedabad State Tax authority.
Received LOI from Govt of Madhya Pradesh for limestone mining lease over 349.709 hectares in Itauri-Jharkua Block, Panna.
Received LOI from Govt of Andhra Pradesh for limestone mining lease over 1188 hectares in Dommarnandyala Block-3, YSR Kadapa District.
Commissioned a new 3 MnTPA grey cement grinding unit at Buxar and increased grinding capacity at Muddapur to 4.50 MnTPA.
Q4FY26 consolidated revenue stood at ₹3,888 Cr and PAT at ₹331 Cr.
FY27 capex guided at INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores.
Paints business revenue targeted at INR500 crores to INR550 crores for FY27 with EBITDA breakeven.
Executed mining lease for Mahan Coal Mine (Underground Coal Mine) at Singrauli, Madhya Pradesh, over 981.75 hectares.
Fuel mix in Q1FY27 was 40% petcoke, 45% Indian coal, balance alternate fuels.
Panna plant overall utilisation above 65% in Q1FY27.
Incentive income accrued in Q1FY27 was around ₹50 Cr; FY29 annual incentive expected ~₹300 Cr.
JK Maxx Paints currently has a capacity of 73,000 KLPA at Bhiwadi, Rajasthan, with a 60% utilisation rate.
Wall putty capacity expansion of 6 lakh MT at Nathdwara, Rajasthan was commissioned on 12th Aug 2026.
Standalone grey cement capacity utilisation stood at 67% in Q2FY27 (clinker utilisation at 95%).
Paints revenue in Q2FY27 stood at ₹116 Cr within consolidated White business net sales.
Security cover for NCDs as of September 30, 2026, stood at 3.76x against a requirement of 1.20x.
Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) for Q2FY27 was 2.12x.
Total Outside Liabilities to Tangible Net Worth was 1.72x as of September 30, 2026.
Fuel mix in Q2FY27: 55% Indian coal, 13% alternate fuels, and balance petcoke.
Clinker utilization reached 95% in Q2FY27.
RMC business has 23 plants in operation, targeting 50 by March 2027.

timeline.summary: On April 23, 2026, JK Cement announced it was declared the preferred bidder for the Karunda Limestone Block-I in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan.
On April 26, 2026, JK Cement announced it was declared the preferred bidder for the Maliyakheri Limestone Block-I in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan.
On April 27, 2026, JK Cement announced an investment of ₹4.22 Cr to acquire a 26% stake in Truere Guj SPV Private Limited for captive solar power.
JK Cement received a minor GST demand order of ₹0.08 Cr from the Ahmedabad tax authority.
On May 20, 2026, JK Cement announced the receipt of a Letter of Intent from the Government of Madhya Pradesh for a limestone mining lease over 349.71 hectares in Panna district.

On May 20, 2026, JK Cement announced the receipt of a Letter of Intent from the Government of Andhra Pradesh for a limestone mining lease over 1,188 hectares in YSR Kadapa District for Dommarnandyala Block-3.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,887.5 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹332.91 Cr.
JK Cement reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹3,888 Cr and PAT of ₹331 Cr.
JK Cement hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 25, 2026, outlining double-digit volume growth expectations and robust capex plans.
On June 5, 2026, JK Cement announced the execution of the mining lease for the Mahan Coal Mine in Singrauli, Madhya Pradesh, over 981.75 hectares.
JK Cement approved a new ₹130 Cr paint plant in Telangana and recommended Price Waterhouse as statutory auditors from 2027.
JK Cement published its Q2FY27 investor presentation, confirming 40 MTPA capacity by FY28 and 50 MTPA by FY30.
JK Cement filed its Q2FY27 security cover certificate
JK Cement Limited made audio recording of earnings call on Tuesday, October 27, 2026 available on its website.
JK Cement reported Q2FY27 results and confirmed its 50 MTPA capacity target by FY30 during its earnings call on October 27, 2026.
